title: Replace Claude native permission-denial approval waits with bounded actionable diagnostics
outcome: A native Claude tool refusal that has no live permission request remains a readable refusal and never parks an auto-approve session behind an inert approval card.
acceptance: A behavioral regression drives the existing Claude tool-result permission-denial shapes under auto-approve and proves that no pending approval/card or silent wait is created when no live decision exists.
A refused native/sandbox/read-only operation retains a bounded actionable reason on the session; real can_use_tool decisions, questions, Stop and read-only admission keep their existing owners.
The parent carries independent paired review without outstanding Medium-or-higher findings and an exact-input full gate for the landed contribution.

completion.summary: A Claude tool call that the CLI refuses no longer parks the session behind an approval card that nothing can answer, and no longer hides Claude's follow-up reply. An auto-approve session now launches with --permission-mode default, the mode a runtime switch selects, so an inherited default mode cannot refuse a tool before the CLI asks TermAl. Refusals are recognised from the CLI's structured tool_result_meta non_execution_kind (user-rejected, permission-rule, automode-*), with stop and unknown kinds keeping their own path. When no kind is stated, one prefix-anchored table of the CLI's captured refusal wordings decides. A refused Bash command counts as abandoned, never as a run. Every refused tool keeps a reason bounded once, at dispatch, to 2,000 characters; that includes Task, AskUserQuestion, the file tools and any future arm. The fix landed in three rounds, each with a confirmed RED, a clean review pair and a passing FULL: 25d92e85 (launch mode and no card), fbe1d556 (the CLI refusal signal) and 5537064c (the bound at dispatch). The independent post-landing evaluation (delegation-5bb5a8c2) passed all 3 criteria on landed master 5537064c. Follow-ups filed: w-96ac97878759 (an entry without a kind counts as run) and w-16b8b6caf3f4 (closes against this landing).
